# `candid linkedin`

Import LinkedIn's official data export (no scraping).

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid linkedin [-h] <subcommand> ...
```

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `import` | Import a LinkedIn export ZIP into your profile. |
| `guide` | How to download your LinkedIn data export. |


### `candid linkedin import`

Import a LinkedIn export ZIP into your profile.

```
usage: python -m candid linkedin import [-h] --zip ZIP [--mode {merge,replace}]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--zip` `ZIP` | Path to the LinkedIn export .zip (required) |
| `--mode` `MODE` | merge: fold into existing profile (default); replace: overwrite (default: merge) |


### `candid linkedin guide`

How to download your LinkedIn data export.

```
usage: python -m candid linkedin guide [-h]
```
